newsitem.title: USA: GE Capital to enter Swiss loan market.
newsitem.headline: GE Capital to enter Swiss loan market.

text.p: GE Capital Services said on Friday that it had agreed to acquire Bank Aufina Ltd, a subsidiary of Union Bank of Switzerland, marking GE Capital's entry into the Swiss car leasing and consumer loan market.
Terms of the deal, which is pending regulatory approval, were not disclosed.

In a joint statement, GE Capital and UBS said the transaction represented GE Capital's first acquisition in Switzerland. Gary Wendt, chief executive of GE Capital, said the transaction "represents an important addition to our increasing presence throughout Europe."
GE Capital Services, a diversified financial services company, has operations in North America, Asia and in the U.K. and is a wholly owned subsidiary of General Electric Co.
